verdict.rationale: Highnote exposes a documented GraphQL API (with API Explorer, test environment, SDKs, webhooks, and an official Node.js SDK) that covers the full product surface—card issuance, spend controls, ledger, disputes—enabling programmatic/agentic control as explicitly marketed for agentic commerce use cases. Missing for 10: no discoverable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (404s on probes) and no independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
